beats.title: temperatures
beats.screen_note: a card showing cpu / gpu temperature; overlay: under 70°C normal, 70 to under 85°C warning, 85°C and above critical. Note the °C / °F toggle in account settings. Then cut to a machine whose cpu temperature slot is empty.

direction.SCREEN: a card showing cpu / gpu temperature; overlay: under 70°C normal, 70 to under 85°C warning, 85°C and above critical. Note the °C / °F toggle in account settings. Then cut to a machine whose cpu temperature slot is empty.
direction.NOTE: since 3.2.0 temperatures come from the PawnIO driver — a machine without it reads a BLANK cpu temperature (gpu temps still arrive via vendor APIs), and reads can be switched off per machine with `"temperature": { "enabled": false }` in config.json. Seed or pick a machine with no cpuTemp for the second half of the shot.

beats.title: network health
beats.screen_note: the card's COLLAPSED metrics summary row — the "ping 12ms" chip and, beside it, the "% loss" chip. Collapse the stats section (or seed statsExpanded false) to bring the row on screen.

direction.SCREEN: the card's COLLAPSED metrics summary row — the "ping 12ms" chip and, beside it, the "% loss" chip. Collapse the stats section (or seed statsExpanded false) to bring the row on screen.
direction.NOTE: latency and packet loss render ONLY in the collapsed summary row; the expanded "network" tile shows the NIC id and ↑tx / ↓rx throughput, neither of which is narrated here. statsExpanded defaults to true and the harness seeds it true, so this beat needs the toggle shut. Seed a degraded machine — latencyMs above 50 for yellow, above 100 for red, and packetLossPct above 0, since the loss chip is hidden at zero.

beats.title: per-device tabs and time range
beats.screen_note: in the panel, show tabs for each disk, gpu, and network adapter; the time-range selector; and the machine switcher in the title bar.

direction.SCREEN: in the panel, show tabs for each disk, gpu, and network adapter; the time-range selector; and the machine switcher in the title bar.
direction.NOTE: two-fixture beat. dashboard-mixed-states seeds 10 machines, which trips the >5 threshold for the title-bar machine switcher — but it writes no per-device history, so the panel shows one disk, one gpu, one nic. Only monitor-single-machine's focus machine has 2 disks + 2 nics; it seeds 4 machines, so no switcher. Record the per-device-tabs half there and the switcher half here, or add disks/gpus/nics history to media-server-stage in seedDashboardMixedStates and shoot it in one take.
